title: Set Up: Like Their Parents, Not the Same
pageTitle: Like Their Parents, Not the Same

scenes.tts: You need three or four fresh pea pods from the grocery store, an apple, a sweet bell pepper, a ruler, and leaves from one plant.

items.text: An apple and sweet bell pepper

scenes.narration: You need three or four fresh pea pods from the grocery store, an apple, a sweet bell pepper, a ruler, and leaves from one plant.

scenes.tts: Open each pod and line the peas up on a plate. Measure each pea across with a ruler. An adult cuts the apple and pepper so the seeds show. Later, look at pictures of animal families.
scenes.narration: Open each pod and line the peas up on a plate. Measure each pea across with a ruler. An adult cuts the apple and pepper so the seeds show. Later, look at pictures of animal families.

scenes.tts: Peas from one pod are alike, but not identical. Look for the biggest, the smallest, and any with a different shade.
scenes.narration: Peas from one pod are alike, but not identical. Look for the biggest, the smallest, and any with a different shade.

scenes.tts: Stay with your child. An adult does all the cutting. Keep peas and seeds away from children under four.

items.text: Adult cuts; seeds away from under-4s

scenes.narration: Stay with your child. An adult does all the cutting. Keep peas and seeds away from children under four.
